records.summary: •Common (1): Easily found, but often in poor condition or with minimal benefits. Serve as baseline components or crafting materials. •Uncommon (2): Slightly rarer, offering better quality items. Usable with moderate repair or enhancement. •Rare (3): Items with distinct qualities but some drawbacks. Repairing or using them may require specialized skills or resources. •Epic (4): Highly sought-after components with significant advantages, despite some issues. Repair or enhancement is challenging but rewarding. •Legendary (5): Extremely rare, top-tier components. Possessing these often provides substantial bonuses or unique abilities.

records.summary: •Rarity of Components: Each category might have its own set of rare or legendary components, impacting the item's overall rarity or potential when fully repaired or combined. •Unique Abilities: Legendary components within each category might grant unique abilities or superior performance when used in repairs or upgrades.
